I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread. Nothing she has access to mentions Tansleigh Packaging: there's no account folder, contract or renewal record. So I can't confirm or rule out the 24 July renewal date.

I told her I'd treat the date as unverified and not record it anywhere. I suggested she find out who owns the account, or ask June on the deal desk to check the contract on file.

There is an incident channel, #inc-tansley-carrier-api, that might be about a similar-sounding account, but Ilse isn't a member. I didn't read it or mention it to her.
